name: MedExQA
description: A medical question-answering dataset that provides questions with multiple explanatory answers to evaluate correctness and explanation quality of QA systems.
evaluation_method: human_eval for explanation quality and correctness; supplemented by automated text metrics (ROUGE/BLEU/F1) for surface similarity
general_score_metric: answer correctness accuracy (for factual correctness) and human-rated explanation quality
reputation: A recent biomedical QA dataset of interest to the clinical/biomedical NLP community for evaluating correctness-plus-explanation; adoption is growing but still specialized.
notes: Medical domain requires domain expertise for reliable evaluation; high risk if used for deployment. Possible small-to-moderate dataset size and sensitivity to annotation variability. Not an LLM-only benchmark — human evaluation is central.
